## Services

### Junk Removal
**Q:** What is junk removal?
**A:** Junk removal is professional hauling of unwanted furniture, appliances, boxes, and clutter from your home or garage. Easy Garage Cleaning provides flat-rate junk removal in Fort Collins after a free on-site walkthrough — we lift, haul, donate usable items, and recycle the rest with no hourly billing.
**URL:** https://easygaragecleaning.com/junk-removal-fort-collins-co

### Garage Cleanout
**Q:** What is a garage cleanout?
**A:** A garage cleanout is a full haul-out of unwanted garage contents — furniture, boxes, tools, and clutter — followed by donation drop-offs and a floor sweep so you can park inside again. We set one flat rate during a free on-site walkthrough; labor, hauling, and dump fees are included.
**URL:** https://easygaragecleaning.com/garage-cleanouts-fort-collins-co

### Garage Cleaning
**Q:** What is garage cleaning?
**A:** Garage cleaning is a post-cleanout reset: sweeping floors, removing dust and cobwebs, and wiping accessible surfaces after junk is gone. It turns an empty garage into a truly clean, usable space — often booked with a garage cleanout in Fort Collins.
**URL:** https://easygaragecleaning.com/garage-cleaning-fort-collins-co

### Garage Organization
**Q:** What is garage organization?
**A:** Garage organization is structured zoning after a cleanout — shelving plans, labeled bins, and layout so items have a permanent home. Easy Garage Cleaning helps Northern Colorado homeowners keep garages clear long-term, not just empty for a week.
**URL:** https://easygaragecleaning.com/garage-organization-fort-collins-co

### Furniture Removal
**Q:** What is furniture removal?
**A:** Furniture removal is pickup and haul-away of couches, beds, dressers, tables, and other bulky pieces from your garage or home. We carry items out, donate what's usable to local charities, and dispose of the rest for one flat rate set during a free on-site walkthrough.
**URL:** https://easygaragecleaning.com/furniture-removal-fort-collins-co

### Appliance Removal
**Q:** What is appliance removal?
**A:** Appliance removal covers fridges, washers, dryers, water heaters, and other large appliances hauled from your property. Working units may go to Habitat ReStore Fort Collins; we handle heavy lifting and proper disposal with flat-rate pricing.
**URL:** https://easygaragecleaning.com/appliance-removal-fort-collins-co

### Mattress Removal
**Q:** What is mattress removal?
**A:** Mattress removal is haul-away of mattresses and box springs from garages, bedrooms, or curbside. We handle the weight and disposal requirements so you do not need a truck rental, with the exact price approved before work begins.
**URL:** https://easygaragecleaning.com/mattress-removal-fort-collins-co

### Storage Unit Cleanout
**Q:** What is a storage unit cleanout?
**A:** A storage unit cleanout empties a paid storage unit in one trip — boxes, furniture, and forgotten items hauled, donated, or disposed. It is ideal when monthly fees exceed the value of what is inside; we set the exact price after seeing the unit.
**URL:** https://easygaragecleaning.com/storage-unit-cleanout-fort-collins-co

### Yard Debris Removal
**Q:** What is yard debris removal?
**A:** Yard debris removal hauls branches, lawn equipment, outdoor furniture, and garage-stored yard clutter from your property. We load, haul, and recycle or dispose — common after storms or when clearing space for parking.
**URL:** https://easygaragecleaning.com/yard-debris-removal-fort-collins-co

### Couch Removal Fort Collins CO
**URL:** https://easygaragecleaning.com/couch-removal-fort-collins-co

## Pricing

| Tier | Range | Scope |
|------|-------|-------|
| Single-item | $99–$150 | One bulky piece |
| Small load | $250–$400 | Partial garage / few items |
| Standard garage | $400–$650 | Typical single or moderate two-car |
| Large / estate | $650+ | Packed two-car, multi-space |

Full guide: https://easygaragecleaning.com/pricing

## Quote Process

1. Call or text (970) 999-1818 to request a walkthrough
2. Request online: https://easygaragecleaning.com/book (service → timing → location → optional photos → contact)
3. Homepage wizard: https://easygaragecleaning.com/#quote
4. Call (970) 999-1818

The request does not reserve an appointment. We confirm the walkthrough, inspect the scope, and set one flat price for approval before work begins. Some projects may require a deposit at booking, as described in the written estimate.

## FAQs

1. **How much does a garage cleanout cost in Fort Collins?** Planning ranges are $99–$150 for a single item, $250–$400 for a small load, $400–$650 for a standard garage, and $650+ for a large job. The exact price is set during a free on-site walkthrough.

2. **How do I request a walkthrough?** Call or text (970) 999-1818, or use https://easygaragecleaning.com/book. Photos are optional and help the crew prepare; exact pricing happens on site.

3. **Do you offer next-day service?** Yes when the schedule allows — often next-day in Fort Collins, Loveland, Windsor, and Wellington.

4. **Are you insured?** Yes — Easy Garage Cleaning LLC is a Colorado-registered LLC with general liability and commercial auto insurance on every job.

5. **Do you donate usable items?** Yes — Habitat ReStore Fort Collins, ARC, and Goodwill when items qualify; tax receipt in the customer's name.

6. **Flat rate or hourly?** Flat rate only. We set one exact price during the on-site walkthrough, and you approve it before work begins.

7. **What is a garage cleanout?** Full haul-out of garage contents you mark for removal, donation drop-offs, and a floor sweep so you can park inside again.

8. **What can't you take?** Liquid paint, gasoline, solvents, asbestos, medical/biohazard waste, live ammunition, and large motor-oil quantities.

9. **Do I need to sort before you arrive?** No — mark what stays; we handle lifting, loading, donations, and disposal.

10. **What's included in the price?** Labor, hauling, dump fees, donation coordination, and basic sweep — no hidden line items.

11. **Easy Garage Cleaning vs GOT-JUNK?** Easy Garage Cleaning is an owner-led local garage specialist with walkthrough-based flat pricing. See the comparison guide for the practical differences.

12. **What areas do you serve?** Fort Collins, Loveland, Windsor, Timnath, Wellington, Severance, LaPorte — Larimer County daily.

13. **Do you haul from inside the garage?** Yes — garage, basement, and ground-floor areas we can access safely.

14. **When do I pay?** After you approve the flat-rate quote — not before the job.

15. **Can I book online?** You can request a free walkthrough online. We contact you to confirm the actual appointment window; submitting the form does not reserve a time automatically.

16. **How long does a garage cleanout take?** Most single-car garages 2–4 hours; full two-car 3–5 hours depending on volume.

17. **Do you sweep after cleanout?** Yes — a basic floor sweep is included so the space is usable immediately.

18. **Single-item pickup price?** Typically $99–$150 for one couch, mattress, or appliance. Complex removals such as hot tubs are priced after inspecting access and scope.

19. **Storage unit cleanout?** Yes. We inspect the unit, confirm what stays and leaves, and set one flat price before work.

20. **Estate or multi-space cleanouts?** Yes. Larger jobs usually start around $650 and receive a custom flat price after the on-site walkthrough.

21. **What happens to items after pickup?** Donations first, then Larimer County Landfill or recycling — never illegal dumping.

22. **Who owns Easy Garage Cleaning?** Zac Bezenek — CSU student, founder, and owner-operator. https://easygaragecleaning.com/about

Full FAQ page: https://easygaragecleaning.com/faq
